prd.title: Styleguide Page
prd.overview: The Styleguide Page is the dev-only design system reference (outside AppLayout per App.tsx). Token reference, 22 primitives gallery, 27 Lucide icons. Closes MAJOR #4: trust band docs updated from 3-band to **5-band** (T0/T1/T2/T3/resolved) and Danger button misuse demo removed. Tier 3 (light, dev-only).

scope.scenarios: Dev-only reference; not in user journeys
scope.platform: Reconcile web/src/pages/StyleguidePage.tsx (847 LOC); MAJOR #4: 5-band docs + Danger misuse removal

requirement.title: Mount /styleguide outside AppLayout
requirement.description: Register route at /styleguide outside AppLayout per App.tsx. Dev-only; not user-facing.

requirement.title: MAJOR #4: 5-band trust docs (T0/T1/T2/T3/resolved)
requirement.description: Update trust band docs from 3-band (T1/T2/T3) to **5-band** (T0/T1/T2/T3/resolved) per lockdown revision. Each band: glyph + text + use-case + example. Closes MAJOR #4 from 02-phase-4-closeout.md §4.3.

acceptance.criterion: 5 bands documented: T0, T1, T2, T3, resolved
Each band has glyph + text + use-case + example
grep 'T1\|T2\|T3' alone (no T0/resolved) returns zero hits in band docs section

requirement.title: MAJOR #4: Remove Danger button misuse demo
requirement.description: Remove any demo showing Danger variant used for non-alert-red-reserved contexts. Danger variant reserved for alert-red issuance path only. Closes MAJOR #4 from 02-phase-4-closeout.md §4.3.

acceptance.criterion: Danger variant only shown in reserved context (alert-red issuance)
No "delete account" / "purge" / destructive-action misuse demo present

requirement.title: Token reference (all --color-trust-* + --color-reporter-*)
requirement.description: Render token reference section: all --color-trust-* (5 bands), --color-reporter-* (4 sources), spacing scale, radii scale, motion tokens. Each token: name + value + usage note.

requirement.title: Component gallery (22 primitives + variants)
requirement.description: Render component gallery: 22 shadcn primitives (Button, Card, Modal, Dropdown, Toast, Tooltip, Input, DatePicker, DateRangePicker, Pagination, BandPill, Tabs, Accordion, etc.) with all variants.

requirement.title: Icon library (27 approved Lucide icons)
requirement.description: Render icon library: all 27 approved Lucide icons with semantic names + use-case notes. Reject any icon not in the approved list.

acceptance.criterion: No icons outside the approved 27 are imported

requirement.title: Live locale + theme toggles
requirement.description: Render live locale (EN/BN) and theme (light/dark) toggles. Toggles affect the entire page in real-time (not just persisted preference).

acceptance.criterion: Locale toggle affects page strings live
Theme toggle affects page colours live

requirement.title: i18n keys (styleguide labels)
requirement.description: Verify styleguide.json (en + bn) is current for section labels, token labels, component labels. EN + BN parity. No Hindi.

requirement.title: MAJOR #4 reconciliation: 5-band docs + Danger misuse removed
requirement.description: Verify trust band docs show 5 bands (not 3); verify Danger variant only shown in reserved context; verify no Hindi strings; verify 22 primitives + 27 icons render.

acceptance.criterion: Danger misuse test passes (no misuse demo)

prd.test-protocol:
[Added last — written when implementation is near complete]
Mount /styleguide; assert band docs section shows 5 bands (T0/T1/T2/T3/resolved); assert each has glyph + text + use-case + example. 5-band docs complete.
Inspect Danger variant usage; assert only in reserved context (alert-red issuance); assert no destructive-action misuse demo. Danger reserved.
Enumerate icons in DOM; assert exactly 27 from approved list; assert no others. Icon library correct.
